blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Engagement is how connected people feel to their work. When employees are engaged, they like their job. They like their team. They feel proud of the company.

Happy people smile more. They help more. A good team has team spirit, and this makes work better every day.

HR wants to know how people feel. Sometimes HR sends a short survey. It asks: "How happy are you at work?" The answers help the company to improve.

items.q: What is engagement?
options: How connected people feel to their work
The number of people on a team
items.why: "Engagement is how connected people feel to their work."

items.q: When people are engaged, they feel proud of…
items.why: "They feel proud of the company."

items.q: Why does HR send a survey?
items.why: "HR wants to know how people feel."

items.q: The text suggests that engaged people…
items.why: Inferência: "Happy people smile more. They help more." — pessoas engajadas ajudam mais.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: surveys are a waste of time
how people feel matters to the company
items.why: Inferência: o texto mostra que HR quer saber como as pessoas se sentem para melhorar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily explicar a pesquisa de engajamento para a equipe. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi everyone! Today I am sending a short survey to the team. It is very quick. It only takes five minutes, so please do it before Friday.

The survey asks how you feel at work. There are simple questions. For example: "How happy are you today?" and "Do you like working with your team?" There are no wrong answers. We just want to know how you feel.

Your answers are private. I do not see your name. HR reads the numbers, not the names. So please be honest. Honest answers help us make small changes that help everyone.

I really enjoy working here, and I like helping this team. But we can always do better. Good team spirit and well-being are important to me. So please, tell us the truth. Thank you very much!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How long does the survey take?
items.why: "It only takes five minutes."

items.q: When should people do the survey?
items.why: "please do it before Friday."

items.q: What does Emily say about the answers?
options: They are posted on the wall
items.why: "Your answers are private. I do not see your name."

items.q: Why does Emily ask people to be honest?
options: Because honest answers help make changes
items.why: Inferência: "Honest answers help us make small changes that help everyone."

items.q: How does Emily feel about the team?
options: She is angry with the team
She does not care about the team
She wants to leave the team
items.why: Inferência: "I really enjoy working here, and I like helping this team."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She feels proud of her team." Proud means…
items.why: Proud = orgulhoso(a): feliz e satisfeito com algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "HR sends a short ___ to ask how people feel."
items.why: Survey = pesquisa: o que o RH envia para saber como as pessoas se sentem.

items.q: "Good team spirit makes work better." Team spirit is…
options: a feeling of working well together
items.why: Team spirit = espírito de equipe: o bom sentimento de trabalhar junto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ working with my colleagues."
items.why: Enjoy = gostar de / curtir. "I enjoy working with my colleagues."

items.q: "Well-being means feeling good at work." It is about…
options: your health and how you feel, body and mind
items.why: Well-being = bem-estar: sentir-se bem, corpo e mente.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out the survey." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher: completar com suas respostas.

items.q: "New colleagues need time to settle in." To settle in means to…
options: get comfortable in a new place
items.why: Settle in = se adaptar, se sentir confortável em um lugar novo.

items.q: "A happy team can cheer up a hard day." To cheer up means to…
items.why: Cheer up = animar, fazer alguém se sentir melhor.

items.q: "Good managers care about their people." To care about means to…
options: feel that someone is important to you
items.why: Care about = se importar com: sentir que alguém é importante para você.

items.q: "Let's find out how the team feels." To find out means to…
items.why: Find out = descobrir, obter informação sobre algo.
